structured_output.notes: Most primary PDFs (ANAROCK, Knight Frank) were unreadable via WebFetch, so figures come from established media or portals reporting them. Excerpts come from WebFetch extractions, and a few may be paraphrased by the fetch summarizer, so spot-check them. The 2025 PropEquity item is a title-only excerpt, never opened. Sources disagree sharply on price growth: ANAROCK about 8%, Knight Frank about 9%, JLL about 15%, PropTiger 24-26%. Months of inventory was not published. Knight Frank uses quarters-to-sell (5.3 for the city). Four items were seen only in search snippets and are not claims: ANAROCK Q2 2026 inventory of ~79,200 units; ANAROCK Q1 2026 average price of Rs 9,310/sq ft; Deccan Herald's >Rs 1.5 crore share of 62% of H1 2026 sales; NHB RESIDEX Bengaluru +11.3% YoY for Jul-Sep 2025. RBI HPI and CBRE Q3 2026 for Bengaluru were not found. The Hindu, TOI, ET Realty, Moneycontrol, NIE, HT, Mint, BMRCL and Karnataka government pages did not surface.
